Theorem
[Euclidean logarithmic Sobolev inequality] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0227 ↗ def:chow-iii-log-sobolev 1. ch22:22.15\group Logarithmic Sobolev

For every $\varphi \in W^{1,2}(\mathbb R^n)$, \[ \int _{\mathbb R^n}(2|\nabla \varphi |^2-\varphi ^2\log \varphi ^2) +\log \! \left(\int \varphi ^2\right)\int \varphi ^2 \ge \left(\tfrac n2\log (2\pi )+n\right)\int \varphi ^2. \]
